facts.fact: MESCTI's Gabinete de Estudos, Planeamento e Estatistica published the 10th edition of the Anuario Estatistico do Ensino Superior 2023-2024 in October 2024, with figures on students, graduates, staff and grants based on information supplied by the higher education institutions and INAGBE.
The yearbook says its figures rest on information supplied by the higher education institutions and the national scholarship institute INAGBE.

systems.country_label: Anuario Estatistico do Ensino Superior 2023-2024 (10th edition)

facts.fact: The MESCTI yearbook says 3,076 (9.8%) of the 31,503 graduates of academic year 2022-2023 were in STEM.
